description: Send an SMS/text message from one of your OpenPhone numbers to up to 10 recipients. WRITE ACTION — this actually sends a real text message (which may incur carrier cost and requires approved A2P 10DLC registration). OpenPhone REST: POST /messages.

from.description: The sending OpenPhone number — a phone-number id ('PN...') or E.164 number, e.g. '+15555555555' (required).

setInboxStatus.description: Set to 'done' to mark the conversation complete after sending.

to.description: Recipients in E.164 format (or contact ids), 1-10 items (required).

userId.description: The sending user id ('US...'); defaults to the phone number's owner.

name: openphone_send_message
title: Send a text message
